title: Lighthouse at the Edge of the Storm

concept.title: Lighthouse at the Edge of the Storm
concept.logline: On storm-lashed, mysterious Fenholm, you set out to recover the lantern cores and restore the Storm Lighthouse.
concept.source_prompt: Storm Isle. storm stormy lighthouse island adventure Classic quest chain
concept.player_fantasy: You are a wanderer who arrives at Gale Harbour and becomes the one who brings the Storm Lighthouse back to life.

key_locations.name: Palm Grove
key_locations.description: Palm Grove: a grove on the way out from Gale Harbour.

characters.name: Keeper Piet
characters.description: Waits in Gale Harbour and knows why the Storm Lighthouse fell silent.

characters.name: Odo the Deckhand
characters.description: Follows you from Gale Harbour and points out anything glinting nearby.

characters.name: Reef Stalker
characters.description: A reef stalker that prowls near its lair and runs down whatever it spots.

characters.name: Tide Sentinel
characters.description: A tide sentinel that walks the same beat over and over. Learn the loop and slip past.

characters.name: Ember the Trader
characters.description: Trades gossip about Fenholm for anything shiny.

characters.name: Sand Piper
characters.description: A harmless sand piper that bolts if you come too close.

objectives_outline: Speak with Keeper Piet in Gale Harbour
hazards: Storm sweeping the exposed ground around the Storm Lighthouse
Reef Stalker hunting near its lair
Tide Sentinel patrolling a fixed loop

actions.value: On storm-lashed, mysterious Fenholm, you set out to recover the lantern cores and restore the Storm Lighthouse.
Keeper Piet: "Find what was lost around Sea Cave, Palm Grove, Shipwreck Cove, then bring the Storm Lighthouse back."
You found the Sea Cave Lantern Core.
You found the Palm Grove Lantern Core.
You found the Shipwreck Cove Lantern Core.
You found the Storm Lighthouse Lantern Core.
The Sea Cave stirs back to life.
The Palm Grove stirs back to life.
The Shipwreck Cove stirs back to life.
Everything is ready. Head for the Storm Lighthouse.
The Storm Lighthouse blazes to life. Lighthouse at the Edge of the Storm is saved.
You are badly hurt. Back off and recover.

nodes.speaker: Keeper Piet
nodes.text: So you've come to Gale Harbour at last. I am Keeper Piet. On storm-lashed, mysterious Fenholm, you set out to recover the lantern cores and restore the Storm Lighthouse.

choices.text: What do you need from me?

nodes.speaker: Keeper Piet
nodes.text: Back again. Gale Harbour is quieter while you're out there.

nodes.speaker: Keeper Piet
nodes.text: Go to Sea Cave, then Palm Grove. Whatever still remembers Lighthouse at the Edge of the Storm is out there. Bring it back to me.

nodes.speaker: Keeper Piet
nodes.text: Before anyone lived in Gale Harbour, Lighthouse at the Edge of the Storm was kept by people who wrote nothing down. Tense, even then.

nodes.speaker: Keeper Piet
nodes.text: Sea Cave: Sea Cave: a cave on the way out from Gale Harbour.

nodes.speaker: Keeper Piet
nodes.text: You found something out there. I can see it on you. That's one piece of Lighthouse at the Edge of the Storm back where it belongs.

nodes.speaker: Keeper Piet
nodes.text: Palm Grove: Palm Grove: a grove on the way out from Gale Harbour.

nodes.speaker: Odo the Deckhand
nodes.text: Odo the Deckhand circles your feet, then looks toward Storm Lighthouse as if it already knows the way.

nodes.speaker: Odo the Deckhand
nodes.text: Odo the Deckhand hums quietly, the way it does before the weather turns.

nodes.speaker: Odo the Deckhand
nodes.text: It turns toward Storm Lighthouse. Storm Lighthouse: the far end of the classic hub and trail, where the story ends.

nodes.speaker: Reef Stalker
nodes.text: The reef stalker watches you, low and still. It is not going to talk.

nodes.speaker: Ember the Trader
nodes.text: Welcome to my corner of Gale Harbour. Ember the Trader's wares have come a long way to get here.

nodes.speaker: Ember the Trader
nodes.text: Rope, oil, dried fruit, and maps of Lighthouse at the Edge of the Storm that are only a little wrong. Nothing you can't find for yourself, if you're patient.

nodes.speaker: Ember the Trader
nodes.text: People say lights move at Palm Grove after dark. I don't go there myself.

nodes.speaker: Sand Piper
nodes.text: The sand piper freezes, watches you with one bright eye, and looks ready to bolt.
